```python
def test_reap_dead_runs_ast_quarantine_check(self):
    """Ensure reap_dead_runs respects quarantine without terminating processes."""
 # Parse the AST to ensure the quarantine check is present but doesn't lead to termination
    source = inspect.getsource(ProcessLifecycle.reap_dead_runs)
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    # Check for the quarantine pattern
    has_quarantine = any(
        isinstance(node, ast.If) and 
        'qu antined' in ast.unparse(node.test).lower()
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
    )
    self.assertTrue(has_quarantine, "reap_dead_runs should check quarantine")
    
    # Check that it doesn't call terminate
    has_terminate = any(
        'terminate' in ast.unparse (node).lower()
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
    )
    self.assertFalse(has_terminate, "reap_dead_runs should not call terminate")
```

``` python
    self.assertEqual(audit_events[0]["decision"], "continued")
```
